inspection: Bundled promiseWithTimeout clears its timer in Promise.race(...).then(...), leaving the rejection path without cleanup. getDownloadOptions reads SEGMENT_DOWNLOAD_TIMEOUT_MINS.
selectionBasis: Optional cache restoration should fall back within the feedback budget; the observed 125 MiB archive transferred at 1.8 MiB/s before aborting. A two-minute segment budget retains room for an ordinary 128 MiB transfer while bounding the residual timer.
validationLimit: The failing transfer was not reproduced after changing the setting; the budget is verified against the pinned action implementation and configuration.
